senya_en.instruct: Young man around 20, energetic and fast-talking, sarcastic Gen Z storyteller, casual American English, bright youthful timbre, expressive and a little dramatic, like a viral TikTok narrator.
senya_en.ref: Okay, so this is gonna sound insane, but my shadow literally walked out on me last night. Like, packed up and left.

shadow2_en.instruct: Playful, cheeky young male voice, early twenties, smooth and charismatic, mischievous grin in the voice, quick comedic timing, clear natural delivery, slightly higher pitch than average, like a cocky best friend.
shadow2_en.ref: Relax, man. I'm not gone gone. I'm just living a little. You should try it sometime, seriously.

narrator_en.instruct: Deep, calm, resonant adult male narrator, movie-trailer voice, slow, authoritative and mysterious, low pitch, clear diction.
narrator_en.ref: In a world where shadows have rules, only one thing matters. Never lose yours.

lines.text: At 11:47 PM my shadow fucked off.
lines.say: At eleven forty-seven p.m., my shadow... fucked. off.

lines.text: I only noticed in the morning.
lines.say: I only noticed in the morning.

lines.text: The cat has one. The kettle has one.
lines.say: The cat has one. The kettle has one.

lines.text: I quit. 26 years following you, and you never go anywhere. Fuck this.
lines.say: I quit. Twenty-six years following you, and you never go anywhere. Fuck this.
Nine thousand, four hundred and ninety times. One routine.

lines.text: Rule number one. No shadow? You last till sunset.
lines.say: Rule number one. No shadow? You last till sunset. Then... you become one.

lines.text: An hour later, the internet found it.
lines.say: An hour later, the internet found it.

lines.text: …and for the first time in a year, I ran.
lines.say: ...and for the first time in a year, I ran.

lines.text: You lived more today than all year.
lines.say: You lived more today than all year.

lines.text: Work is work. But get out. Mix it up.
lines.say: Work is work, man. But get out. Mix it up.

lines.text: New terms. Sign it, and I'll come back.
lines.say: New terms. Sign it, and I'll come back.

lines.text: That shadow at the club… the ponytail… the moves…
lines.say: That shadow at the club... the ponytail... the moves...

lines.text: So… do we help the Shadow get the girl? Tell us in the comments.
lines.say: So... do we help the Shadow get the girl? Tell us in the comments!

lines.text: When she flipped that hair, I forgot I'm 2D.
lines.say: When she flipped that hair... I forgot I'm two-dimensional.

lines.text: And she's a ten. In every light.
lines.say: And she's a ten. In every light.
